name: The Boat
dinnerNote: Evening tasting menu (also served at lunch)

menus.name: Evening tasting menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner; alcohol-free pairing £55; optional scallop course £15

menus.name: Lunch choice menu
menus.note: Starter, main and dessert with snacks and treats; Thursday to Saturday lunch

bookingOpens: Online through OpenTable on the restaurant's website, by email (dine@theboat.restaurant) or by phone.
cancellation: Card details secure the booking. Cancellations 24 hours or more ahead are free; within 24 hours a £40 per person fee may apply, and no-shows may be charged the minimum menu price for that service.
walkIns: Walk-ins are taken when possible, but not guaranteed. Tables are held for up to an hour after the booking time.
groups: Groups of six or more pay a £40 per person deposit to book, non-refundable but transferable to a future visit.
children: Not recommended for children under 8. There is no children's menu, and no highchairs or prams.
duration: About 2½ hours for the evening menus and 1 to 1½ hours at lunch.
